title: Wiener and Average Distance of Irregular Square-Cell Configuration
summary: A subgraph of the square lattice with all of its inner faces being 4-cycles is called a square-cell configuration. Prior work has provided explicit expressions for the total and average distances between vertex pairs in symmetric square-cell configurations, including well-structured families such as hexagonal square-cell configurations $H(n)$, trapezium square-cell configurations $T(n,k)$, and bitrapezium square-cell configurations $BT(n,k_1,k_2)$.
